name: Smart Watchdog + Progress Heartbeat
description: Replace the simple no-output kill timer with an intelligent watchdog that checks child processes and /proc I/O activity before killing. Adds progress heartbeat messages during long turns.

target.semantic_description: The compiled JS file that manages live CLI session execution, handles watchdog no-output timeouts, and can close/abort sessions

steps.description: Add child_process import for PID monitoring
Replace resetNoOutputTimer with full watchdog + progress system
steps.semantic_anchor: The function named 'resetNoOutputTimer' that takes a single 'session' parameter. It clears any existing noOutputTimer on the current turn and sets a new setTimeout that eventually kills the session by calling closeLiveSession with a timeout error. This is a standalone function definition, NOT the call sites that invoke it.

steps.description: Replace initial turn timer with watchdog-aware version
steps.semantic_anchor: Inside the createTurn function, the 3-line block that sets turn.noOutputTimer to a setTimeout. This setTimeout calls closeLiveSession with 'abort' and a createTimeoutError mentioning 'no output'. It uses params.noOutputTimeoutMs as the delay. Just the 3 lines for the no-output timer, NOT the timeout timer block that follows it (which uses params.context.params.timeoutMs).

steps.description: Add progress timer cleanup to clearTurnTimers
steps.semantic_anchor: The function named 'clearTurnTimers' that takes a 'turn' parameter. It clears noOutputTimer and timeoutTimer by calling clearTimeout and setting them to null. It is a standalone function, typically around 9-10 lines.

steps.description: Add setTimeout to capture baseline child PIDs after session start
steps.semantic_anchor: The line containing '__sessionKey: params.context.params.sessionKey' (the one we just added as the last property before the closing brace of the session object). We want to find the CLOSING BRACE line '}; ' that immediately follows it — the one that ends the session = { ... }; object literal.
steps.code: setTimeout(() => { try { session.__baselineChildPids = __ocGetChildPids(managedRun.pid); console.error("[WATCHDOG] baseline captured:", [...session.__baselineChildPids].join(",")); } catch {} }, 30000);

steps.description: Remove resetNoOutputTimer from stderr handler (MCP noise was blocking watchdog)
steps.semantic_anchor: The onStderr callback handler in the session spawn options. It's a function that takes a 'chunk' parameter, appends it to session.stderr, checks if stderr exceeds CLAUDE_LIVE_MAX_STDERR_CHARS (closing the session if so), and calls resetNoOutputTimer(session). The entire callback from 'onStderr: (chunk) =>' through its closing brace.

steps.description: Add progress:done signal to finishTurn (1st clearTurnTimers occurrence)
Add progress:done signal to failTurn (2nd clearTurnTimers occurrence)
